title: Prime London property values down 25% as tax changes bite
summary:
Prime Central London property values have fallen by up to 25% in some cases as tax changes targeting non-domiciled residents impact the upper end of the market. Properties above £15 million have been particularly affected, with international buyers historically accounting for around 70% of transactions in this segment.

title: Newcastle leads rental yields at 6.9%, national average hits 5.9%
summary:
Newcastle upon Tyne has emerged as the highest-yielding rental market in England, with average yields reaching 6.9%, according to new research from The Letting Partnership. The analysis calculated the national average rental yield at 5.9%, derived from an average house price of £293,262 and monthly rent of £1,446.

title: Student landlords face Ground 4A possession deadline
summary:
The upcoming academic year marks the first test of new possession rules for student landlords following changes introduced under the Renters' Rights Act. Landlords who missed transitional deadlines are unlikely to obtain possession under Ground 4A during the remaining 2026 window.

title: Scottish and northern commuter towns lead price growth
summary:
Commuter locations around Glasgow and Manchester have dominated annual asking price growth, accounting for ten of the 15 strongest performers across six major UK cities. Falkirk recorded the strongest growth at 13.5% year-on-year to £183,596, while southern commuter towns saw prices decline.

title: Estate agency AI platform secures £1m in pre-seed funding
summary:
ClearPath AI has secured £1m in pre-seed funding for its artificial intelligence platform designed to automate routine tasks in residential property transactions. The company's Property AI product targets estate agencies, using AI to handle processes from instruction and onboarding through to offers and sales progression.

title: Private property network rebrands as listings reach £4bn
summary:
Private property network Oskar has rebranded as Oskar Prime after the value of listings shared through the platform approached £4bn. The platform currently has £3.97bn of homes listed and £3.12bn of active buyer searches across 479 agents representing 229 companies.

title: Tribunal upholds £7,500 fine for electrical safety breaches
summary:
A tribunal has upheld a £7,500 penalty issued to a landlord company for failing to address electrical safety defects within the legal timeframe. West Suffolk Council imposed the fine on Forthbrook Ltd after the company took 82 days to complete works that should have been finished within 28 days.

title: Landlords lose 73% of rent tribunal cases, data shows
summary:
Nearly three quarters of rent dispute cases decided by property tribunals since January 2025 have resulted in lower rents than landlords proposed, according to analysis by LonRes. The research found that 47% of tribunal decisions cited evidence problems when ruling on rent increases.

title: Industry expert identifies common house moving pitfalls
summary:
A removals industry veteran with over 30 years' experience has outlined seven frequent mistakes homeowners make during property relocations, highlighting issues that can significantly impact moving costs and timelines.

title: Conveyancing fraud costs UK homebuyers £78,000 on average
summary:
UK homebuyers lost an average of £78,393 to conveyancing fraud in 2024-25, with Report Fraud recording 140 property-related cases. The scams involve criminals intercepting email communications between buyers and solicitors to divert payments to fraudulent accounts.
